Read the 'Shortcut hints are separate from dispatch rules' finding against the changed registry: hints still derive from ids; the new plugin rules (namespacing, reserved-chord refusal and dispatch skip, typing guard) do not change hint derivation. No prose change.

Updated the Keyboard shortcuts section: plugins register through SDK useShortcut, namespaced plugin.<owner>.<id> at priority 0 by src-ui/src/core/sdkShortcutsHost.ts; dispatch skips and registration refuses a reserved kernel chord from src-ui/src/contexts/kernelReservedShortcuts.ts. Checked against KeyboardShortcutsContext dispatch and the SDKAdapter.hostServices tests.
App.tsx now takes the Settings and shortcut-list chords from kernelReservedShortcuts; the developer.open registration and the shortcut note are unchanged. No prose change.

App.tsx change is limited to sourcing the Settings and shortcut-list chords from the reserved table (same bindings); placement and external-link claims (openExternalLink http(s)-only) remain accurate and are what useHost().openExternal delegates to. No prose change.

The SDK barrel now re-exports PaneHostFacts and PaneConfirm* types and SDK useHost/useHostFacts reuse the shared confirm chrome and facts derivation. The contract itself is unchanged; prompt is SDK-only (in-process) and not a contract member, which docs/reference/sdk.md states. No prose change.
providers.tsx adds host and shortcuts slots and deprecation notes; this guide's provider/agent claims do not describe SDK context slots. No prose change.
sdk.md gained Host service hooks and a rewritten Keyboard Hooks section; this guide routes to the SDK reference without restating hook availability. No prose change.

Added 'Plugin shortcuts': SDK registration under plugin.<plugin>.<id>, listing and modal suppression, priority 0 relative to view shortcuts and fallbacks, reserved ⌘K/⌘,/⌘/ refused by default and current binding and skipped at dispatch after rebinding, cmd/ctrl equivalence off a Mac, modifier-less typing guard, and the not-a-sandbox limit for in-page plugins. Each claim maps to an SDKAdapter.hostServices test except cmd/ctrl equivalence (reasoned from effectiveChordSignature).

Added Host service hooks (useHost clipboard/openExternal/prompt/confirm, useHostFacts) and rewrote Keyboard Hooks (useShortcut, useShortcutScope, deprecated useKeyboardShortcut(s)); updated the default-binding table. Checked each against packages/sdk/src/hooks/context.ts, host-contexts.ts, SDKAdapter.tsx, sdkShortcutsHost.ts and the station dev mock, and their tests.

Added useHost, useHostFacts, useShortcut/useShortcutScope to the pane SDK hook list, regenerated src-server/tools/station-docs-content.ts with docs:mcp:generate. Checked return shapes and reserved chords against the SDK source.
SDKAdapter adds host/shortcuts slots and renders shell confirm/prompt chrome beside children; the example's documented hooks and composition are unchanged. No prose change.
SDKAdapter change adds slots without changing useAgents/useToast/dock behaviour this README tabulates. No prose change.
Still routes to docs/reference/sdk.md and forbids app-internal imports; the new hooks are public SDK exports. No prose change.
Hooks section says the host adapter supplies contexts; still true for the new host/shortcuts slots, which docs/reference/sdk.md documents. No prose change.
